task: T-008 (Li2FeSiO4 mp-18968 candidate vs LiFePO4 mp-19017 baseline on voltage; D-004 option A, kickoff 2026-10-30)

seeds.note: CHGNet inference is deterministic; seed recorded for completeness

input_provenance: pipeline/data/raw/<id>/provenance.json (stage 1, MP db 2026.09.28; mp-18968 pulled 2026-10-30 by stage1_pull_t008.py, named explicitly by Mico at kickoff; mp-19017 pulled by T-003 stage 1)

settings.arrangements_policy: one arrangement per lithiation state: x_max uses the pulled MP structure as-is; x=0 removes all Li from the same cell (vacancy-ordered framework). RQ-2 cap recorded in manifest: LiFePO4 has 4 Li sites per 4-fu cell (24 orderings); Li2FeSiO4 Pmn2_1 has 8 Li sites per 4-fu cell (2 Li/fu, 8!/(2!^4) = 2520 distinct arrangements by site-occupancy count); this run relaxes 1 per state, same cap as T-003/T-004.
settings.li_reference: bcc Li, conventional 2-atom cell a=3.5093 A, relaxed with the same model/optimizer/fmax/cell relaxation. Never a database Li energy (D-rule).

rq_flags.RQ-2: arrangement cap: 1 per state (LFS Pmn2_1: 8 Li sites/4-fu cell; LFP: 4 Li sites/4-fu cell)
rq_flags.RQ-3: magnetic ordering: CHGNet internal magmom prediction (assign_magmoms=true); no explicit FM/AFM constraint

comparison.metric: predicted average voltage, full lithiation window of the host formula unit (D-004 option A; LFS window is 0->2 Li/fu, LFP 0->1 Li/fu)
comparison.baseline_run_value_ref: run-20261021-t003-g1 predicted 3.4239 V (0->1 window); this run re-relaxes the baseline for a within-run comparison
